Aesthetic mappings for gig plots

gig_aes.Rd

Describes how columns of the plot data map to the visual channels of the geom_*() layers, so that every layer shares one mapping vocabulary. Aesthetics are given as bare column names or expressions, as in ggplot2::aes(). Aesthetics left as NULL are dropped.

Usage

gig_aes(
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  trend = NULL,
  seasonality = NULL,
  remainder = NULL,
  colour = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x, y

The two primary variables. geom_features() reads them as the initial feature columns on the horizontal and vertical axes. geom_stl() reads x as the time index and y as the observed series.

trend, seasonality, remainder

STL component columns, required by geom_stl(). They are never guessed from column names.

colour, group

Reserved for future use. They are stored on the mapping but not yet used by any layer.

...

Further aesthetics, stored but not interpreted.

Value

An object of class gig_aes, a named list of quosures.

See also

gig(), geom_features(), geom_stl()

Examples

gig_aes(x = trend_strength, y = seasonal_strength_year)
#> <gig_aes>
#>   x -> trend_strength
#>   y -> seasonal_strength_year
gig_aes(
  x = Quarter, y = Trips, trend = trend,
  seasonality = season_year, remainder = remainder
)
#> <gig_aes>
#>   x -> Quarter
#>   y -> Trips
#>   trend -> trend
#>   seasonality -> season_year
#>   remainder -> remainder
